name: deepgram
long_description: Bring your Deepgram project API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite. Saving or replacing a key and each connection test run a roughly 18-second sample transcription charged to your Deepgram account. Other transcription and synthesis requests are also charged by Deepgram. Supports POST /v1/listen for prerecorded audio and POST /v1/speak for HTTP synthesis. Audio responses are buffered, not incremental. WebSocket realtime speech and Voice Agent are not supported. Request bodies are limited to 8 MB with a 120-second upstream timeout; prefer a publicly reachable audio URL for larger input.
